integrity: A complete analytic proof and an independent, standard-library, rational-arithmetic reproduction script are included. Numerical tests do not replace infinite-parameter arguments.
scientific_limitations: Uniform ternary alphabet and Pearson orientation only; exact moments in the open range 0<m<2/3; no global claim for other f-divergences. Full-support boundary suprema need not be attained. No independent validation.
title: Sharp Pearson quasi-projection collapse and minimax moment-only repair on three atoms
